tobool - config coercion (a .toml or -flag value is a STRING or SYMBOL)
reach the internal config coercion
every truthy form coerces to true including single characters and symbols
every falsy form coerces to false
the result is a boolean ATOM - a raw boolean$ cast would give one per character

tolong - numeric config (a -flag override is a STRING)

a command-line override is a string and is PARSED not cast

an unparseable number is a configuration error not a silent null
